question: Will Bitcoin close above $64,000 on August 5, 2026?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the CoinGecko closing price of Bitcoin (BTC) for August 5, 2026, as shown in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Bitcoin Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-05, is strictly greater than $64,000.00. A close of exactly $64,000.00 or below resolves NO.
